items.name: OpenAlex Snapshot
items.description: Comprehensive open-access bibliographic database covering publications, authors, institutions, venues, and concepts across all scientific fields. Replacement for Microsoft Academic Graph.

items.name: Semantic Scholar January 2025
items.description: Most recent Semantic Scholar snapshot with comprehensive paper metadata, venues, years, and author linkages. Includes 2024-only subset for studying recent publications.

items.name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph December 2024
items.description: S2AG snapshot with papers, authors, citations, and S2ORC (Open Research Corpus) full text data. Includes processing scripts for parallel extraction.

items.name: Microsoft Academic Graph December 2021
items.description: Final snapshot of Microsoft Academic Graph before discontinuation in 2022. Irreplaceable historical data with comprehensive publication, author, institution, and citation coverage. Includes schema documentation.

items.name: DBLP Computer Science Bibliography January 2025
items.description: Comprehensive computer science publication bibliography in both XML and JSON Lines format. Includes parser utilities.

items.name: Dimensions Database Snapshot
items.description: Commercial research database snapshot covering publications, citations, grants, patents, clinical trials, and policy documents. Enterprise-grade bibliometric data with broader coverage than academic-only databases.

items.name: PubMed Knowledge Graph v2.0
items.description: Comprehensive biomedical knowledge graph integrating PubMed articles with NIH grants, clinical trials, patents, MeSH terms, biological entities, and author-inventor linkages. Authoritative NIH-sourced data.

items.name: iCite Bulk Snapshot
items.description: NIH iCite system data tracking citations, Relative Citation Ratios (RCR), field-normalized metrics, and NIH grant linkages for biomedical research. Authoritative data for studying biomedical research impact.

items.name: PATSTAT Global Patent Database
items.description: European Patent Office PATSTAT database with global patent bibliographic information, citations, classifications, and legal status. Gold standard for patent research. Includes OECD complementary datasets.

items.name: Papers with Code March 2025
items.description: Most recent Papers with Code snapshot linking academic papers to code implementations, datasets, and benchmarks. Valuable for reproducibility and state-of-the-art tracking in ML/AI.

items.name: Papers with Code November 2024
items.description: Papers with Code dataset with paper-code linkages, evaluation tables, and method descriptions.

items.name: ArXiv and Preprint Metadata
items.description: ArXiv metadata snapshot plus bioRxiv and medRxiv preprint data. Documentation on data collection using R medrxivr package and Kaggle ArXiv snapshot.

items.name: Patent Description and Summary Similarity Matrices
items.description: Massive pre-computed N x N similarity matrices for patent descriptions and summaries across multiple time periods (1995-2010). Represents months/years of computation on patent text similarity. Enables research on technological evolution, creative destruction, and knowledge integration.
items.warning: GUARD CAREFULLY - Single most computationally expensive asset in lab directory

items.name: MAG Abstract PMI Word Statistics
items.description: Massive pre-computed Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) word co-occurrence statistics for scientific abstracts spanning over a century. Organized by temporal bins (1800-1920+). Enables longitudinal analysis of scientific language evolution, concept emergence, and semantic change.
items.temporal_organization: yearbin0-11 files with cx (word counts) and cxy (word co-occurrence counts)

items.name: Longitudinal Ambiguity Analysis Dataset
items.description: Large-scale ambiguity analysis dataset spanning multiple years with systematic partitioning. Valuable for semantic uncertainty in text, scientific language evolution, and concept clarity research.

items.name: Concept Co-occurrence and Author-Concept Mappings
items.description: Comprehensive concept pair analysis and author-concept relationships from bibliometric data. Hierarchical concept classifications (levels 1 and 2). Valuable for knowledge graphs and field relationship analysis.

items.name: Author Career Length and Field Classifications
items.description: Large-scale bibliometric analysis with author career trajectories and author-paper-field mappings. Focus on physics (APS) and computational linguistics (ACL) publications.

items.name: Author Gender Inference Dataset
items.description: Comprehensive author gender inference dataset covering OpenAlex and Web of Science. Contains processed name-to-gender mappings for US and international authors with first and middle name analysis.

items.name: Web of Science Author and Citation Data
items.description: WoS bibliometric data with author addresses, citation topics, paper-author relationships, and medical/pharmaceutical database linkages (MeSH, ChEBI, WHO ATC).

embeddings._note: Pre-trained embedding models and generated embeddings

items.name: SPECTER2 Citation Embedding Models
items.description: State-of-the-art citation-based document embedding model from Allen AI. Creates embeddings capturing semantic similarity based on citation patterns. Multiple formats available (base, HuggingFace, full with weights).

items.name: Google News Word2Vec Embeddings
items.description: Pre-trained Word2Vec embeddings trained on Google News corpus. 300-dimensional vectors for general language tasks.

items.name: Materials Science Embeddings (mat2vec)
items.description: Domain-specific embeddings for materials science applications including crystal structure analysis.

items.name: Hyperbolic Geometry Models
items.description: Cached hyperbolic geometry models for hierarchical knowledge representation. Sophisticated approach to embedding hierarchical structures.

items.name: OpenAlex Paper Embeddings
items.description: Generated embeddings for OpenAlex papers. 16K files across 6 subdirectories.

items.name: Patent Embeddings
items.description: Generated embeddings for patent documents. 8K files across 3 subdirectories.

items.name: MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) Embeddings
items.description: Generated embeddings for Medical Subject Headings. 12 subdirectories.

items.name: PatentsView Novelty Embeddings
items.description: USPTO patent data with pre-computed novelty embeddings organized by year. Part of the apto data engineering pipeline.

items.name: Reddit and Telegram Social Media Data
items.content_description: Social media data for the 'ideolect' project analyzing linguistic patterns. PostgreSQL database infrastructure for structured queries.

items.name: 4chan and Reddit Toxicity Datasets
items.content_description: Toxicity-scored datasets for 4chan (/pol/ board) and Reddit content. Includes production-quality data cleaning scripts.

items.name: COVID-19 Weibo Dataset
items.content_description: COVID-19 related Chinese social media (Weibo) dataset.

items.name: Large-Scale Reddit Data Collection
items.content_description: Extensive Reddit data with millions of entries (4M without scores, 2M with scores). Used for LLM social simulation and stance detection research.

items.name: Political Text Corpora (Conservative/Liberal)
items.content_description: Large-scale political text corpora with conservative/liberal labels, including both human-written and GPT-generated text. Valuable for political NLP, bias detection, and studying AI-generated political content.

items.name: Psychology Perspectives and Priors Data
items.content_description: Massive compressed psychology datasets on perspectives, priors, and behavioral game theory (public goods games). Computational modeling of social behavior.

shared_infrastructure._note: LLM caches, databases, and shared resources

items.name: Shared LLM Model Cache
items.purpose: Shared cache for large language models. Saves significant download time/bandwidth for multiple researchers.

items.name: Hugging Face Model Cache
items.purpose: Shared Hugging Face transformer model cache for multiple users.

items.name: Ollama Model Cache
items.purpose: Ollama model cache for running LLMs locally. World-writable for shared access.

items.name: Database Software Installations
items.purpose: Database software installations for graph and relational databases.
items.note: Old versions from 2022-2023, may need updating

items.name: APTO Data Engineering Pipeline
items.purpose: Central data engineering repository aggregating multiple scientific preprint servers, patent data, and academic literature. Multi-researcher collaboration workspace.
